<?php
// E2E probe (test only): stands in for the gateway. Records the kind of each call (never a key, token or card number).
// Scenario (option cz_scn): ok | disc_reply (approved sale whose reply says the card is a Discover) | disc_reply_voidfail (same, and the void is declined).
function cz_scn() { return (string) get_option( 'cz_scn', 'ok' ); }
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
	$url = (string) $url;
	if ( false === strpos( $url, 'transact.php' ) && false === strpos( $url, 'query.php' ) ) { return $pre; }
	parse_str( is_string( $args['body'] ) ? $args['body'] : http_build_query( (array) $args['body'] ), $b );
	$log = get_option( 'cz_log', array() );
	$ok  = array( 'headers' => array(), 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	if ( false !== strpos( $url, 'query.php' ) ) { return $ok + array( 'body' => 'Authentication Failed' ); }
	$type  = $b['type'] ?? 'sale';
	$log[] = array( 'call' => $type, 'saved_card' => ! empty( $b['customer_vault_id'] ), 'new_token' => ! empty( $b['payment_token'] ) );
	update_option( 'cz_log', $log, false );
	if ( 'void' === $type ) {
		if ( 'disc_reply_voidfail' === cz_scn() ) { return $ok + array( 'body' => 'response=3&responsetext=Void failed&response_code=300' ); }
		return $ok + array( 'body' => 'response=1&responsetext=Transaction Void Successful&transactionid=' . ( $b['transactionid'] ?? '' ) . '&type=void&response_code=100' );
	}
	$body = 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&authcode=123456&transactionid=T' . wp_rand( 1000, 9999 ) . '&avsresponse=N&cvvresponse=M&orderid=' . ( $b['orderid'] ?? '' ) . '&type=' . $type . '&response_code=100';
	if ( 0 === strpos( cz_scn(), 'disc_reply' ) ) { $body .= '&cc_type=Discover'; }
	if ( ! empty( $b['customer_vault'] ) ) { $body .= '&customer_vault_id=V' . wp_rand( 100000, 999999 ); }
	return $ok + array( 'body' => $body );
}, 10, 3 );
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( isset( $_GET['cz_set'] ) ) {
		update_option( 'cz_scn', sanitize_key( $_GET['cz_set'] ) ); delete_option( 'cz_log' );
		$s = get_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', array() );
		if ( isset( $_GET['cz_enf'] ) ) { $s['enforce_card_brands'] = 'yes' === $_GET['cz_enf'] ? 'yes' : 'no'; }
		if ( isset( $_GET['cz_allow'] ) ) { $s['allowed_card_brands'] = array_filter( explode( ',', sanitize_text_field( $_GET['cz_allow'] ) ) ); }
		update_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', $s );
		header( 'Content-Type: application/json' ); echo '{"ok":true}'; exit;
	}
	if ( isset( $_GET['cz_seed'] ) ) { // a saved Discover card for the shopper
		$u = get_user_by( 'login', 'shopper' );
		$t = new WC_Payment_Token_CC(); $t->set_gateway_id( 'cardz3n_gateway' ); $t->set_token( 'VSAVED1' ); $t->set_user_id( $u->ID );
		$t->set_card_type( 'discover' ); $t->set_last4( '1117' ); $t->set_expiry_month( '12' ); $t->set_expiry_year( '2030' ); $t->add_meta_data( 'cardz3n_vault_id', 'VSAVED1', true ); $t->save();
		header( 'Content-Type: application/json' ); echo wp_json_encode( array( 'token_id' => $t->get_id() ) ); exit;
	}
	if ( empty( $_GET['cz_state'] ) ) { return; }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	$u = get_user_by( 'login', 'shopper' );
	$orders = wc_get_orders( array( 'customer_id' => $u->ID, 'limit' => 1, 'orderby' => 'id', 'order' => 'DESC' ) );
	$o = $orders ? $orders[0] : null;
	$notes = $o ? array_map( function ( $n ) { return preg_replace( '/\s+/', ' ', wp_strip_all_tags( $n->content ) ); }, wc_get_order_notes( array( 'order_id' => $o->get_id() ) ) ) : array();
	echo wp_json_encode( array( 'order_id' => $o ? $o->get_id() : 0, 'order_status' => $o ? $o->get_status() : null, 'notes' => $notes, 'gateway_calls' => get_option( 'cz_log', array() ) ) );
	exit;
} );
